problem_text:
A manufacturing firm must allocate its production across ten distinct regional warehouses to fulfill predetermined order quantities at minimal distribution expense.

The production capacity at each manufacturing facility (set F) is listed as:
*F1 can produce 59 units.
*F2 can produce 186 units.
*F3 can produce 178 units.
*F4 can produce 80 units.
*F5 can produce 73 units.
*F6 can produce 173 units.
*F7 can produce 83 units.
*F8 can produce 188 units.
*F9 can produce 50 units.
*F10 can produce 160 units.

The required fulfillment volume for each regional warehouse (set W) is:
*W1 must receive 69 units.
*W2 must receive 8 units.
*W3 must receive 98 units.
*W4 must receive 42 units.
*W5 must receive 147 units.
*W6 must receive 145 units.
*W7 must receive 70 units.
*W8 must receive 108 units.
*W9 must receive 136 units.
*W10 must receive 139 units.

The per-unit distribution cost from each manufacturing facility to each warehouse is provided in the following matrix:

| From / To | W1 | W2 | W3 | W4 | W5 | W6 | W7 | W8 | W9 | W10 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| F1 | 19 | 4 | 14 | 5 | 9 | 16 | 8 | 3 | 10 | 20 |
| F2 | 18 | 14 | 9 | 7 | 1 | 1 | 19 | 17 | 4 | 17 |
| F3 | 1 | 13 | 7 | 11 | 14 | 12 | 4 | 5 | 14 | 19 |
| F4 | 9 | 9 | 18 | 14 | 19 | 12 | 20 | 9 | 13 | 7 |
| F5 | 14 | 18 | 18 | 16 | 6 | 12 | 18 | 18 | 16 | 9 |
| F6 | 10 | 19 | 12 | 13 | 5 | 4 | 8 | 15 | 6 | 4 |
| F7 | 7 | 17 | 13 | 11 | 18 | 20 | 2 | 6 | 13 | 1 |
| F8 | 3 | 5 | 16 | 20 | 14 | 3 | 3 | 9 | 8 | 12 |
| F9 | 3 | 20 | 2 | 13 | 13 | 20 | 17 | 10 | 20 | 2 |
| F10 | 6 | 16 | 15 | 1 | 7 | 17 | 10 | 7 | 2 | 20 |

Determine the optimal allocation of units to ship from each facility to each warehouse in order to minimize the aggregate distribution expenditure.
